data.title: IAEA's Grossi: Watchdog unable to verify Iran’s nuclear program for over a year | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Speaking to the IAEA's Board of Governors, Grossi said the watchdog's lack of information on Iran’s nuclear program is a "serious proliferation concern" and "needs to be rectified."
data.keywords: IAEA,Iran,uranium,Iran Nuclear Deal,Israel Iran War,International Atomic Energy Agency,nuclear program,Rafael Grossi
